episode_title: EPISODE 5 · BLOODLINES (A HAND HOLDS ACROSS TIME)
subject: Dayton childhood basement, southern-wood rafters, and ancestral archive at WYGWYL #t=493.9 (Beat 42 / WGY041 / P05-008)
protagonist: Boone (as The Poet), a handmade cardboard & AI-cel cut-out figure with an amber-ochre scarf and melanated brown skin
supporting_cast: The Ancestor / Builder (sharing the base body rig in an indigo/ivory work coat, plus SAM 2.1 archive hands)
defining_passage: A hand holds the southern-wood beam and the ancestral vessel across time until the bricked-up basement wall opens to the archive.
experiment: The Grip & Registered-Strata Rule: Every code-rigged cut-out & ink figure takes its colour statistics (clamped 0.10..0.90) and edge light-wrap from the whole archive plate, with melanated OKLab skin; while gripping or standing, world-space palm and sole socket errors are held under 1% of protagonist height (<3.8 px), and the archive enters only inside diegetic world surfaces or via a world-coordinate registered wipe.
credits_block: Lead production designer: Amy Hartsoe (the scarf, the shoes, the materials). Lead theatrical surgeon / doctor of narrative arts: Henry (hands, where they go). Straw weaponsmith: Brittany. The slopling: Watson (AI services). Named by Mark Hartsoe. Boone made by (the maker).
